title: You Can See Everything has the biggest opening weekend for a doc in 20 years.
summary: Nathan Fielder’s three-hour documentary about Elizabeth Holmes raked in $15 million in its opening weekend. That’s double expectations and enough to place it in second place at the box office this weekend, behind only Street Fighter .
